attchmntText: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Corporate Presentation for November 2026'.
voiceSummary: Authum Investment and Infrastructure Limited filed a business update and corporate presentation for November 2026 with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. The presentation outlines the company's investment strategy across flow investments, strategic investments, and its ARC platform ISARC. As of September 30, 2026, the investment book size is Rs. 13,568.9 Cr, with Rs. 8,779.0 Cr in strategic investments. The company reported total profit booked of Rs. 155.7 Cr from exits during FY26 and Rs. 1,512.0 Cr from exits in H1 FY27. Cumulative unrealized profits on existing investments stand at Rs. 2,869 Cr. Key strategic holdings include Prataap Snacks and NITCO Ltd.
